procedure.step: Register the factory with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism before applying for a certificate of origin; registration requires the factory to be located outside a free zone, a MoIAT industrial licence, and a MoIAT letter confirming 40% domestic value added, and takes about 3 working days.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: The issuing authority may require the certificate application to include the HS code, description, quantity and value of the exported product, with each item qualifying separately in its own right, and may ask for detailed cost sheets and conduct a factory visit.

Apply for the Certificate of Origin for India through the Ministry of Foreign Trade e-service by logging in to the ministry e-services portal, choosing the Certificate of Origin for India service, filling in the application form, uploading the required documents, paying the fee online, and submitting the application.
Pay the certificate fee of AED 50 for an invoice value up to AED 100000.

The competent authority issues the certificate before, at, or within five working days of the date of exportation; the certificate is valid for twelve months from the date of issue for one import only, and may be issued retrospectively up to 12 months from the date of shipment marked 'ISSUED RETROSPECTIVELY'.

The Indian importer claims the CEPA rate when filing the bill of entry and must hold origin information under CAROTAR 2020, including which origin criterion is claimed, and keep supporting documents for at least five years from filing; the importer must answer a customs request within 10 working days.
The exporter must keep origin records, including the cost breakdown, for at least five years starting from the end of the year of the date of the certificate's issue.

caveats.note: India charges duty on the assessable (CIF) value at import, so actual amounts will differ from the estimate shown.

The CEPA rate applies only if the product qualifies under the rules of origin and a valid certificate of origin is presented.
